Edge 0 set to none cripples node 1, so adding a conv recovers the most.
Removing a strong conv on an output edge costs more than removing a weak op.
Deleting a strong conv is more negative than deleting a weak one.

Edge 4 starts at node 1, which is dead when edge 0 is none, so the edit is disconnected.
A conv on a disconnected edge from the dead node 1 has near-zero effect.
